segments.name: Landscape Supply
segments.description: Distributes landscape supplies such as hardscapes, irrigation, fertilizer, nursery goods and outdoor lighting to residential and commercial landscape contractors through branch locations.
segments.evidence: We manage our business as a single reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Residential and commercial landscape professionals, primarily landscape contractors, pay for landscape supplies and value-added consultative services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers are primarily residential and commercial landscape professionals who specialize in the design, installation, and maintenance of lawns, gardens, golf courses, and other outdoor spaces.
